hints.title: Monthly Weather Average Classification
hints.text: Filter weather observations to November 2019, calculate average weather_state per country, and categorize using conditional logic.

hints.title: Case When Weather Thresholds
hints.text: Assign Cold when average <= 15, Hot when average >= 25, and Warm otherwise.

hints.title: Weather Classification Blueprint
hints.text: select c.country_name, case when avg(w.weather_state) <= 15 then "Cold" when avg(w.weather_state) >= 25 then "Hot" else "Warm" end as weather_type from Countries c join Weather w on c.country_id = w.country_id where w.day between "2019-11-01" and "2019-11-30" group by c.country_id, c.country_name.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
SELECT c.country_name,
       CASE 
           WHEN AVG(w.weather_state) <= 15 THEN 'Cold'
           WHEN AVG(w.weather_state) >= 25 THEN 'Hot'
           ELSE 'Warm'
       END AS weather_type
FROM Countries c
JOIN Weather w ON c.country_id = w.country_id
WHERE w.day BETWEEN '2019-11-01' AND '2019-11-30'
GROUP BY c.country_id, c.country_name;
```

complexity.notes: Filtering by November date range and grouping country ids takes linear time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating weather outside November 2019 corrupts the monthly average temperature.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Inner join only categorizes countries with recorded November observations.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Date range filtering and conditional CASE statement on aggregate AVG.
